name: RANT pays out BNB for tokens sent to the token contract
summary: A flash-loan-funded buy of 9.66e25 RANT from the RANT/WBNB pair followed by a single transfer of 1.07e25 RANT into the RANT token contract returned enough BNB to repay the loan and keep 311 BNB, i.e. RANT's transfer handler redeems tokens sent to itself out of its own reserves at a rate detached from the pool price.
